spec.label: Exploratory lower-turnover momentum; prior holdout failure is preserved
spec.universe: Same 12 eligible Wallex USDT markets, no outcome-selected assets
spec.variants_unit: hours between scheduled rebalances and maximum holding time
spec.rebalance: Allow a same-time exit and entry at the scheduled next open; charge both fills, even when the selected asset is unchanged
spec.features: Closed hourly EMA200; 7-day and 28-day returns; 7-day return volatility; ATR14 on strictly completed daily bars
spec.entry: At scheduled UTC midnight: both momentum returns positive, close above hourly EMA200, 7-day gross momentum above twice assumed round-trip cost; choose highest (7-day return minus cost) / 7-day volatility
spec.risk: One spot-long position, max 100 USDT all-in; 0.1% account planned risk; stop 2 daily ATR; target 2R net; no averaging down
spec.costs: Unchanged fee 0.2% per side; historical spread proxy max(15 bps round trip, measured current per-market spread); additional slippage 1 bp per side
spec.stress: Double spread and extra slippage, unchanged fees
spec.evaluation: Full available replay after feature warmup; both variants reported, no selecting a winning date interval; no claim of an untouched holdout or prospective live performance
spec.reason: Reduce fee turnover and let movements develop; weekly reference may exceed the three-day challenge horizon
